description: This file defines a React component named SidebarLayout that renders a sidebar with navigation links and a header with some user info and controls. It manages authentication state, including tenant and company IDs, and allows logging out. The component is used as a layout component in a Next.js application.

methods.name: updateAuth
methods.description: Updates the authentication data for tenantId or companyId and updates local state.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Clears authentication data and redirects to the home page.
